Now if Timotiyos comes, see that he may be with you without fear; for the avodas kodesh of Hashem he labors in as I do.
Therefore, let not anyone despise him. But give him a send-off in shalom that he may come to me; for I am waiting for him with the Achim b'Moshiach.

Now, concerning Apollos the Ach b'Moshiach, I strongly exhorted him, that he would come to you with the Achim b'Moshiach. But he is beshum oifen
absolutely unwilling to go at this time, but he will come whenever he has an opportunity. FINAL SHALOM GREETINGS FROM REBBE, MELECH HAMOSHIACH'S SHALIACH
